studies.title: Nattokinase and Arterial Plaque
studies.tested: Nattokinase, an enzyme from natto (fermented soybeans), 6,000 FU a day
studies.result: The study reported a reduction in common carotid IMT (the thickness of the artery wall in the neck) and in plaque size.
studies.rating_note: Hermes rates this evidence as early: promising, not proven.
